Among the most comprehensive and advanced healthcare systems in the world, UCLA Health is consistently recognized as one of the nation’s premier academic health systems. Through the dedication of its exceptional faculty and staff, UCLA Health delivers world-class patient care, groundbreaking research, and transformative education while fostering an environment where people can thrive professionally and personally.
UCLA Health is seeking an accomplished and visionary
Senior Director, Organizational Development & Learning
(Senior Director) to lead the organization's enterprise learning, leadership development, talent growth, and organizational effectiveness strategies.

, the Senior Director serves as the executive leader responsible for shaping and advancing UCLA Health’s vision as a high-performing learning organization. This role will drive integrated strategies that strengthen leadership capability, elevate employee experience, support organizational transformation, and ensure employees at all levels have access to meaningful professional growth opportunities.

The Senior Director will lead a team of organizational development and learning professionals and oversee the design, implementation, measurement, and continuous evolution of enterprise-wide leadership development, employee learning, organizational effectiveness, and change management initiatives. This leader will work closely with executive leadership, operational leaders, and HR partners to build the capabilities necessary to support UCLA Health’s strategic priorities and future growth.
Developing and executing a comprehensive enterprise-wide organizational development and learning strategy aligned with UCLA Health’s mission, vision, and strategic priorities.
Leading leadership development programs that prepare current and future leaders to successfully navigate growth, transformation, and organizational complexity.
Designing and implementing change management, talent development, succession planning, coaching, and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
Partnering with senior executives, HR leaders, and operational stakeholders to enhance employee engagement, leadership capability, workforce effectiveness, and career development.
Expanding access to learning and professional development opportunities across UCLA Health’s diverse and geographically distributed workforce.
Establishing measurement frameworks and analytics that assess learning effectiveness, leadership impact, employee experience, retention, and organizational outcomes.
Leveraging best practices and emerging trends in organizational development, workforce development, leadership education, and adult learning to drive innovation and organizational performance.
Building and developing a high-performing Organizational Development & Learning team while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Representing UCLA Health nationally as a thought leader in learning, leadership development, and organizational effectiveness.
